GUIDE_PLAN_EXPLAIN_MORE.text: 诗歌、圣经经文、公告、视频、场景，按顺序排列
GUIDE_PLAN_EXPLAIN_MORE.back: Hymns, Bible passages, announcements, videos, scenes, arranged in order

GUIDE_PLAN_ADD.text: 按下带框的按钮，添加到礼拜里
GUIDE_PLAN_ADD.back: Press the framed button, add to the service

GUIDE_PLAN_ADD_MORE.text: 在打开的列表里选择要添加的内容
GUIDE_PLAN_ADD_MORE.back: In the list that opens, choose what to add

HELP_SCREENS.text: 决定哪块屏幕给现场会众看，哪块给舞台上的乐队看
HELP_SCREENS.back: Decide which screen the people in the room see and which the band on stage sees

HELP_PHONE.text: 同一无线网络里的手机，可以在场内任何位置翻动幻灯片
HELP_PHONE.back: A phone on the same wireless network can flip slides from any spot in the room

HELP_LISTEN.text: 通过麦克风听现场的声音，推荐诗歌或经文。它自己不会上屏
HELP_LISTEN.back: Listens to the room's sound through a microphone and recommends songs or verses. It never goes on screen itself

GUIDE_SCREENS_SWITCH.text: 这个开关用来打开和关闭投影屏
GUIDE_SCREENS_SWITCH.back: This switch is used to turn the projector screen on and off

GUIDE_SCREENS_SWITCH_MORE.text: 关闭时，现场观众的屏幕上什么都不会出现
GUIDE_SCREENS_SWITCH_MORE.back: When off, nothing appears on the audience's screen
GUIDE_SCREENS_SWITCH_MORE.why: plain volunteer register, table words reused

GUIDE_PHONE_OPEN.text: 按下带框的按钮，打开手机遥控
GUIDE_PHONE_OPEN.back: Press the framed button to open the phone remote

GUIDE_PHONE_OPEN_MORE.text: 同一无线网络的手机，都能当幻灯片遥控器
GUIDE_PHONE_OPEN_MORE.back: Phones on the same wireless network can all act as slide remotes

GUIDE_PHONE_SWITCH.text: 先打开开关，再用手机相机扫二维码
GUIDE_PHONE_SWITCH.back: First turn the switch on, then scan the QR code with the phone camera

GUIDE_PHONE_SWITCH_MORE.text: 手机随后会要这里显示的PIN码，输入后就能翻幻灯片
GUIDE_PHONE_SWITCH_MORE.back: The phone then asks for the PIN shown here, and after entering it can flip slides

GUIDE_LISTEN_OPEN.text: 按下带框的按钮，打开语音识别
GUIDE_LISTEN_OPEN.back: Press the framed button to open voice recognition

GUIDE_LISTEN_OPEN_MORE.text: 程序通过麦克风听现场的声音
GUIDE_LISTEN_OPEN_MORE.back: The program listens to the room's sound through the microphone

GUIDE_LISTEN_MICS.text: 选一个能听到现场的麦克风
GUIDE_LISTEN_MICS.back: Pick a microphone that can hear the room

GUIDE_LISTEN_MICS_MORE.text: 听到的内容会推荐在预览上方，不会自己上屏
GUIDE_LISTEN_MICS_MORE.back: What is heard is recommended above the preview and never goes on screen by itself

CAL_EVERY_2_WEEKS.why: sibling of 每周; 两, not 二, before a unit

CAL_EVERY_2_MONTHS.why: sibling of 每月; 个 is needed with 月 after a number

CAL_CUSTOM.why: the usual menu word for a setting the person makes

CAL_EVERY.why: reads as 每隔 3 周; 隔 says the gap between two meetings

CAL_UNIT_WEEKS.why: the 周 of the table; counts after a number

CAL_UNIT_MONTHS.why: 个月 is the counted form after a number, unlike bare 月

CAL_THIS_EVENT.why: 改 names the action; 这一次 is the one opened date

CAL_THIS_AND_FOLLOWING.text: 这一次及之后的所有活动
CAL_THIS_AND_FOLLOWING.back: This time and all the events after it
CAL_THIS_AND_FOLLOWING.why: also reads inside the drop sentence; 活动 is the table word

CAL_ALL_EVENTS.why: 活动 as in the table, 所有 as in 所有日历

CAL_ASK_TITLE.back: Which times of the event to change?
CAL_ASK_TITLE.why: plain question with 哪几次 and a full-width question mark

CAL_CANCEL_DATE.why: 取消 on one 次 cannot read as 删除 of the event

CAL_MOVE_DATE.back: Move this one time to another date
CAL_MOVE_DATE.why: 改期 is what a volunteer says of a moved meeting

CAL_RESTORE_DATE.why: one word; not 撤销, which is Undo

CAL_ALL_DATES.why: an action on the series, clearly not 撤销

text.open: 每隔{every}周的{days}，{start}至{end}，从{from}开始，没有结束日期。

rule_weeks.back: every {every} weeks on {days}, {start} to {end}, from {from} until {until} / with no end
rule_weeks.why: the table rule_week wording with 每隔 and 周 added

text.until: 每隔{every}个月的{position}{weekday}，{start}至{end}，从{from}开始，到{until}为止。
text.open: 每隔{every}个月的{position}{weekday}，{start}至{end}，从{from}开始，没有结束日期。

rule_months.back: every {every} months on the {position} {weekday}, {start} to {end}, from {from} until {until} / with no end
rule_months.why: the table rule_month wording with 每隔 and 个月 added

date_cancelled.why: date first; 已取消, not 已删除

date_restored.why: same shape as the cancel toast

date_moved.why: the new day comes last, as the point

dates_moved_all.back: All dates of {name} were changed together
dates_moved_all.why: 全部日期 says all, not one

scope_drops.why: starts with the button name; one form

series_changed.back: The repeating dates of {name} were updated
series_changed.why: 重复日期 keeps it from sounding like a deletion

GUIDE_SCREENS_JOBS.back: Assign a use to each screen
GUIDE_SCREENS_JOBS.why: plain volunteer register, table words reused

GUIDE_SCREENS_JOBS_MORE.text: 投影屏给观众看，舞台屏给台上的乐手看，或者不使用
GUIDE_SCREENS_JOBS_MORE.back: Projection screen is for the audience, stage screen for the players on stage, or not used
GUIDE_SCREENS_JOBS_MORE.why: plain volunteer register, table words reused

HELP_STREAM.text: 把投影屏的画面和现场的声音，实时送到视频网站上直播。
HELP_STREAM.back: Sends the projection screen's picture and the venue's sound live to a video site
HELP_STREAM.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

HELP_WEB.text: 在网上找一首诗歌的歌词，核对后导入到自己的诗歌里。
HELP_WEB.back: Find a hymn's words online, check, then import into your own hymns
HELP_WEB.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

HELP_PPTX.text: PowerPoint可以按原样导入，也可以把文字用程序自己的样式重新排。
HELP_PPTX.back: A PowerPoint can be imported as is, or its text re-laid in the program's own style
HELP_PPTX.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_STREAM_OPEN.text: 按下带框的按钮，打开直播
GUIDE_STREAM_OPEN.back: Press the framed button to open the livestream
GUIDE_STREAM_OPEN.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_STREAM_OPEN_MORE.text: 投影屏的画面连同现场声音实时播出
GUIDE_STREAM_OPEN_MORE.back: The projection screen's picture goes out live with the venue sound
GUIDE_STREAM_OPEN_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_STREAM_FIELDS.text: 把视频网站给你的地址和密钥粘贴进来
GUIDE_STREAM_FIELDS.back: Paste in the address and key the video site gives you
GUIDE_STREAM_FIELDS.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_STREAM_FIELDS_MORE.text: 两样都在视频网站的开始直播页面上
GUIDE_STREAM_FIELDS_MORE.back: Both are on the video site's start-live page
GUIDE_STREAM_FIELDS_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_STREAM_START.text: 礼拜开始时，按下开始直播
GUIDE_STREAM_START.back: When the service begins, press Start livestream
GUIDE_STREAM_START.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_STREAM_START_MORE.text: 打开录像后，这台电脑上也会留下视频文件
GUIDE_STREAM_START_MORE.back: With recording on, a video file is also left on this computer
GUIDE_STREAM_START_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_OPEN.text: 按下带框的按钮，去网上找诗歌
GUIDE_WEB_OPEN.back: Press the framed button to look for hymns online
GUIDE_WEB_OPEN.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_OPEN_MORE.text: 程序会到诗歌网站上查找，并显示找到的歌词
GUIDE_WEB_OPEN_MORE.back: The program searches hymn sites and shows the words found
GUIDE_WEB_OPEN_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_FIND.text: 输入诗歌标题、诗歌本编号或网页地址
GUIDE_WEB_FIND.back: Enter a hymn title, hymnal number or web page address
GUIDE_WEB_FIND.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_FIND_MORE.text: 选一条结果，歌词就显示在右边
GUIDE_WEB_FIND_MORE.back: Pick a result and the words show on the right
GUIDE_WEB_FIND_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_BROWSER.text: 找不到时，用浏览器搜索
GUIDE_WEB_BROWSER.back: When not found, search with the browser
GUIDE_WEB_BROWSER.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_BROWSER_MORE.text: 把选中页面的地址复制下来，粘贴回这个搜索框
GUIDE_WEB_BROWSER_MORE.back: Copy the chosen page's address and paste it back into this search box
GUIDE_WEB_BROWSER_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_IMPORT.text: 导入按钮会把这首诗歌加进教会的诗歌
GUIDE_WEB_IMPORT.back: The import button adds this hymn to the church's hymns
GUIDE_WEB_IMPORT.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_WEB_IMPORT_MORE.text: 先核对歌词，不按导入就不会保存
GUIDE_WEB_IMPORT_MORE.back: Check the words first; without pressing import nothing is saved
GUIDE_WEB_IMPORT_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_PPTX_OPEN.text: 按下带框的按钮，选一个PowerPoint文件
GUIDE_PPTX_OPEN.back: Press the framed button and pick a PowerPoint file
GUIDE_PPTX_OPEN.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_PPTX_OPEN_MORE.text: 先显示它的幻灯片，还没有添加任何东西
GUIDE_PPTX_OPEN_MORE.back: Its slides show first, nothing added yet
GUIDE_PPTX_OPEN_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_PPTX_WAY.text: 幻灯片可以按原样做成图片，也可以重新排
GUIDE_PPTX_WAY.back: Slides can be made into pictures as is, or re-laid
GUIDE_PPTX_WAY.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_PPTX_WAY_MORE.text: 重新排会用程序的样式，并把表格里的人和奉献提供给会友和奉献窗口
GUIDE_PPTX_WAY_MORE.back: Re-laying uses the program's style and offers the people and gifts in the tables to the Members and Offerings windows
GUIDE_PPTX_WAY_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_PPTX_IMPORT.text: 导入按钮会把幻灯片加进公告
GUIDE_PPTX_IMPORT.back: The import button adds the slides to the announcements
GUIDE_PPTX_IMPORT.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

GUIDE_PPTX_IMPORT_MORE.text: 不按导入，就不会添加任何东西
GUIDE_PPTX_IMPORT_MORE.back: Without pressing import, nothing is added
GUIDE_PPTX_IMPORT_MORE.why: table words reused; plain volunteer register

NOTICE_NEXT_WEEK.why: 周 as in the table's CAL_WEEK

NOTICE_NEXT_MONTH.why: plain month word, same as 本月 in the table

NOTICE_HIGHLIGHT.why: verb heading, 突出 is the familiar word for standing out

NOTICE_HL_PAST.why: ends yesterday, today is its own choice

NOTICE_CUT.text: 突出的日子限在卡片读取的范围内，自定范围最长一年，已按此缩短
NOTICE_CUT.back: Highlighted days are kept inside the range the card reads, a custom range is at most one year, shortened accordingly
NOTICE_CUT.why: two short clauses, no blame on the reader

SETTINGS_WEEK_START.back: Which day the week starts on
SETTINGS_WEEK_START.why: asks the question the two weekday names answer

text.other: 取自会友名单，共 {count} 人，突出 {marked} 人

read_members_marked.back: From the member list, {count} people in all, {marked} stand out
read_members_marked.why: extends the table's 取自会友名单 wording

HELP_SONGS.text: 诗歌写一次就行，歌词和各段都存好，随时可以投出来。
HELP_SONGS.back: Write a song once; the words and parts are kept, and it can be shown any time.

HELP_BIBLE.text: 圣经经文可按书卷、章、节查找，也可按其中的字句查找
HELP_BIBLE.back: Bible passages can be found by book, chapter, verse, or by words in them

GUIDE_SONG_NEW.text: 按下带框的按钮，新建诗歌
GUIDE_SONG_NEW.back: Press the framed button, new song

GUIDE_SONG_NEW_MORE.text: 歌词也可以从别处粘贴进来
GUIDE_SONG_NEW_MORE.back: The words can also be pasted in from elsewhere

GUIDE_SONG_WORDS.text: 在这里输入或粘贴歌词
GUIDE_SONG_WORDS.back: Type or paste the words here

GUIDE_SONG_WORDS_MORE.text: 空一行，就开始下一张幻灯片
GUIDE_SONG_WORDS_MORE.back: Leave a blank line and the next slide begins

GUIDE_SONG_PARTS.text: 给每一段命名，如主歌、副歌、桥段
GUIDE_SONG_PARTS.back: Name each part, such as verse, chorus, bridge

GUIDE_SONG_PARTS_MORE.text: 光标放在某一段里，再按这段名称的按钮
GUIDE_SONG_PARTS_MORE.back: Put the cursor in a part, then press the button with that part's name

GUIDE_SONG_SAVE.text: 保存后，诗歌就归入教会的诗歌
GUIDE_SONG_SAVE.back: After saving, the song joins the church's songs

GUIDE_SONG_SAVE_MORE.text: 之后搜索可按标题或歌词找到它
GUIDE_SONG_SAVE_MORE.back: After that, search can find it by title or words

GUIDE_BIBLE_OPEN.text: 按下带框的按钮，查找圣经经文
GUIDE_BIBLE_OPEN.back: Press the framed button, find Bible passages

GUIDE_BIBLE_OPEN_MORE.text: 经文会按教会选定的圣经译本显示
GUIDE_BIBLE_OPEN_MORE.back: The passage shows in the Bible translation the church selected

GUIDE_BIBLE_BOOKS.back: First pick the book, then chapter and verses

GUIDE_BIBLE_BOOKS_MORE.text: 经文随即进入预览，随时可以投出
GUIDE_BIBLE_BOOKS_MORE.back: The passage then enters Preview, can be shown any time

GUIDE_BIBLE_TYPE.text: 也可以直接输入经文出处，或其中的字句
GUIDE_BIBLE_TYPE.back: You can also type the reference directly, or words in it

GUIDE_BIBLE_TYPE_MORE.text: 如约翰福音 3:16，或记得的几个字
GUIDE_BIBLE_TYPE_MORE.back: Such as John 3:16, or a few words you remember

PART_NEW.why: table's word for a song part, short

EDITOR_DETAILS.why: table's word for a song part, short

PART_REMOVED.why: table's word for a song part, short

PHONE_PAIRED.why: 连接 matches the phone page

PHONE_CONTROL.why: one short phrase for the starting level

PHONE_EDIT.why: level above, same 编辑 as the Edit button

PHONE_EDIT_PIN_HINT.text: 手机连接时输入这个，代替第一个PIN码
PHONE_EDIT_PIN_HINT.back: Type this when the phone connects, in place of the first PIN code

PHONE_EDIT_RULE.text: 在这里允许之前，手机不能改文字。关闭手机遥控，所有手机的权限都会收回。
PHONE_EDIT_RULE.back: Until you allow it here, a phone cannot change the words. Turn the phone remote off and every phone loses its permission.
PHONE_EDIT_RULE.why: 文字 is the everyday word for slide words

PHONE_EDIT_BUSY.text: 手机的修改已丢弃，因为这里正在编辑同一项
PHONE_EDIT_BUSY.back: The phone's change was dropped because the same item is being edited here

PHONE_EDIT_OLD.text: 手机的修改已丢弃，因为它改的是旧版文字
PHONE_EDIT_OLD.back: The phone's change was dropped because it changed an old version of the words

phone_label.why: phone word, number, then kind after a comma

STYLE_GREIGE.why: a printed order of service on paper

STYLE_NEON.why: the usual word for glowing night lights

ANNOUNCEMENT_QRIS.why: QRIS stays; 图片 as in the picture row

SETTINGS_CHURCH.why: 教会 is the church word

TOUR_END.why: uses the table's 导览, unlike 跳过

PART_TOO_LONG.text: 这行太长，投影机放不下
PART_TOO_LONG.back: This line is too long, the projector cannot fit it
PART_TOO_LONG.why: short warning, projector word from table

PART_SPLIT.why: one word, cuts line in two
